title: Repair rule/action/condition fidelity and discovery relationships
description:
Repair known rule/action/condition findings, including Search/Help structure, condition
lifecycle relationships, exhaustion/rest interactions, and source/discovery metadata.
Rules may remain source prose interpreted by the DM. Add structured representation where
it serves source fidelity, discovery, state integrity, or a positive deterministic capability.
design:
Depends on the A4 in-band readiness schema for rules. Reconcile the rule
disposition work against the existing 2026-07-06 artifacts before re-deriving:
docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-8-rule-classification.md and
2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-8-1-rule-disposition-layer-design.md. Those artifacts
predate the closure of eshyra-o9bd.18.7.8 and eshyra-2n1t; their conclusions must
be re-verified against the current pack, not assumed.
acceptance_criteria:
- Known Search/Help/condition/exhaustion findings are source-faithfully represented or explicitly dispositioned.
- Existing correct condition projections are preserved.
- Runtime discovery can surface governing/related rule material and known exceptions.
- Pack data consumed by a capability in force is source-faithful; that capability's contract, execution, and state evidence belong to the capability lane (eshyra-o9bd.19.5 / eshyra-olc5).
- Prose/model adjudication remains a valid default; absence of structured mechanics is never proof of no mechanic.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
COUNT HYGIENE: every number in this bead is a SNAPSHOT at commit 4384f25. The
generated ledger/predicate is authoritative. No acceptance test may require a
hand-copied number (e.g. 391, 399, 77, 79).

Pack projection and reference-engine implementation are CO-DESIGNED. Do not
split them into two isolated efforts that meet only at the end.

This bead pairs with: nearly every family — engine:F1 through F10.

Coordinate decomposition and conformance scenarios with those epics under
eshyra-olc5. The reference engine is the executable VALIDATOR of this bead's
modeling contract, not a downstream consumer waiting for finished data: a
representation that cannot drive execution is not done, however complete it
looks in isolation. Expect this bead's schema and projectors to be revised
together with the engine as conformance tests expose contract gaps.

executionReadiness engineHooks families — NOT the CLOSED epic eshyra-2n1t's
different F1-F10, and NOT the fable:F1..F8 audit findings.
